summary: Open steel Aermotor tower with a 7x7 cab on Cibollito Peak, Isleta-Acoma reservation land; registered 2022; construction date and use unknown, standing.

facts.design: 50-foot open steel Aermotor tower with a 7x7 observation cab; a residence cabin is also on site

access.note: NHLR places the lookout on the Isleta-Acoma Indian Reservation; no visitor rules in the sources read

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register as US 1649, NM 48 on July 7, 2022

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register uses Brushy (Cibollito) and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list uses Brushy (Cebollita). Both refer to the same tower at about 34.72 N, 107.85 W.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only detailed source is the NHLR entry, which says construction date and use status are unknown. The Forest Lookouts page for Brushy gives only a header and the agency name, with no history text. Two searches turned up no staffing, fire, or construction history. Access is recorded as restricted only because the Register puts the tower on Isleta-Acoma reservation land; no visitor rule was found. Brief's access 'unknown' has been changed to restricted on that basis. Not read: the OpenStreetMap way (tags only: tower type observation, no operator), Mapcarta (search snippet only). The Register's 'Nominated by' name was not used.
